notes.subject: כמתלהמים
notes.rationale: Pointed as 'to rankle/burn in' but consonants near מתלעות 'dainty morsels' (LXX, ASV, JPS); KJV reads 'wounds' — I follow the morsels reading.

notes.subject: bel
notes.rationale: חדרי בטן 'rooms of the belly' rendered as inner rooms of the belly; בטן also means womb/bosom.

notes.subject: ירדו חדרי בטן
notes.rationale: Same verse as 18:8 verbatim — refrain-like repetition marking the slander theme.

translation: Ol tok bilong man i waswasaut i olsem kaikai swip, na ⟨i⟩ go daun long ol rum insait bilong bel.
